title: Step 3 - Fine-Tuning Random Forest: From 10 to 500 Trees for Accurate Prediction

cues.en: -: Let's see what prediction we get.
cues.zh: 看看預測結果。

cues.en: Remember that this employee said that its previous salary was a 160K and now let's see what says a random forest composed of 10 trees.
cues.zh: 員工聲稱過去薪資為 160K，現在看看十棵樹的森林怎麼說。

cues.en: So, let's execute that.
cues.zh: 執行。

cues.en: And it says that a previous salary was $141,000 but that's actually a very dangerous prediction because we are way below the 160K salary
cues.zh: 它說過去薪資是 141,000 美元。這個預測很危險，因為遠低於他聲稱的

cues.en: that this new employee said to have in its previous company.
So, if we trust this prediction, we would actually think this employee is bluffing.
cues.zh: 如果相信這個預測，就會認為他在虛報。

cues.en: But no worries, we will not stop here.
cues.zh: 別擔心，我們不會停在這裡。

cues.en: Right now we're going to try a random forest with a lot more than 10 trees.
cues.zh: 現在試試遠超過十棵樹的隨機森林。

cues.en: So, let's speak for example a hundred trees and let's see what we'll get.
cues.zh: 例如 100 棵，看看結果。

cues.en: So I'm going to rebuild the model.
cues.zh: 我重新建立模型。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 完成。

cues.en: And now let's look at the graphic results.
cues.zh: 先看圖形。

cues.en: And as I was telling you, we don't get much more steps in this plot of our new random forest regression.
cues.zh: 如剛才所說，新森林的圖形沒有多出很多階梯。

cues.en: You know, we multiplied our number of trees by 10 but the number of steps was definitely not multiplied by 10.
cues.zh: 樹數乘以十，但階數絕對沒有乘以十。

cues.en: If we compare, we can compare that very quickly.
cues.zh: 可以快速比較。

cues.en: This is the previous plot and this is the new one.
cues.zh: 這是舊圖，這是新圖。

cues.en: 10 trees, 100 trees.
cues.zh: 十棵樹，與一百棵樹。

cues.en: We can see that we have maybe a little more steps but definitely not 10 times the previous steps.
cues.zh: 階數可能略多，但絕對不到原來十倍。

cues.en: So the reason for this, the explanation is related to this convergence idea that I talk to you about.
cues.zh: 原因就是剛說的收斂概念。

cues.en: And so what changes here with a hundred trees in terms of the plot is not the number of steps that was increased but a better choice, a better location
cues.zh: 一百棵樹帶來的圖形變化，不是階數增加，而是階梯沿薪資軸的位置

cues.en: of the steps in the stairs with respect to our salary access.
cues.zh: 選得更好。

cues.en: That means that maybe the steps are better located to make our ultimate predictions of the salaries of each of our level from one to 10 incremented by open one.
cues.zh: 也就是對職等 1 到 10、每次增加 0.1 的薪資，階梯位置可能更適合預測。

cues.en: So, to check that out, we simply need to make our final prediction to predict the salary of this 6.5 level.
cues.zh: 要確認，只需預測職等 6.5 的薪資。

cues.en: So, let's recap.
cues.zh: 回顧一下。

cues.en: The employees saying a 160K.
cues.zh: 員工說 160K。

cues.en: Our random forest with 10 trees said 141K.
cues.zh: 十棵樹的森林說 141K。

cues.en: And now let's see what say our random forest with a hundred trees.
cues.zh: 現在看看一百棵樹。

cues.en: Execute.
cues.zh: 執行。

cues.en: And now it says 166K, so, much better.
cues.zh: 現在是 166K，好多了。

cues.en: We're getting close to the supposed real salary of 160K and besides, we're now actually on the good side of negotiation because we would no longer think that this employee is bluffing.
cues.zh: 接近所聲稱的真實薪資 160K，而且談判方向對我們有利，因為不會再認為他在虛報。

cues.en: So, since the prediction seems to be improving as we increase the number of trees, let's actually try it with 500 trees.
cues.zh: 既然樹增加後預測改善，再試 500 棵。

cues.en: So, that's a huge forest we have now.
cues.zh: 現在是一大片森林。

cues.en: So, let's execute this to build our new huge forest of 500 trees.
cues.zh: 執行，建立包含 500 棵樹的新森林。

cues.en: Here we go, new forest created.
cues.zh: 新森林已建立。

cues.en: Let's have a quick look at the visualization plot results but it's gonna be the same thing.
cues.zh: 快速看看圖形，不過情況會相同。

cues.en: We will not get a lot of more stairs, maybe a little more well actually let's check it out.
cues.zh: 階數不會多很多，也許略多，實際確認一下。

cues.en: Well, definitely not.
cues.zh: 確實沒有。

cues.en: We seem to have the same number of steps in the stairs but as I was telling you, each of the steps in the stairs might actually be better located to make each ultimate prediction
cues.zh: 看起來階數相同，但如剛所說，每階的位置可能更適合預測

cues.en: of the salaries for each of the 10 levels here.
cues.zh: 十個職等各自的薪資。

cues.en: So, the best way to check that out is actually to get our ultimate prediction of the salary of this 6.5 level.
cues.zh: 最好的確認方式，仍是預測職等 6.5 的薪資。

cues.en: And let's check it out.
cues.zh: 現在檢查。

cues.en: Let's see if we get a better prediction than the 166K.
cues.zh: 看看是否優於 166K。

cues.en: Executing.
cues.zh: 執行。

cues.en: And right in the spot we hit the bullseye with a hundred and sixty four hundred and fifty eight predicted salary.
cues.zh: 正中目標，預測薪資為 160,458。

cues.en: So, awesome job that this random forest with 500 trees just did here because it predicted almost the same salary as to suppose the 160K salary that this future employee said to have
cues.zh: 這個 500 棵樹的森林做得很好，預測幾乎和這位未來員工聲稱

cues.en: in its previous company.
cues.zh: 前公司給的 160K 一樣。

cues.en: And actually so far before we made this random forest with 500 trees the best model that made the closest prediction to this 160K salary was the polynomial regression model.
cues.zh: 在建立這個森林之前，最接近 160K 的是多項式迴歸。

cues.en: And now the random forest regression is beating the polynomial regression model cause now we get a prediction that is almost the same as a real value.
cues.zh: 現在隨機森林超越了多項式迴歸，因為預測幾乎等於真實值。

cues.en: So right in the spot.
cues.zh: 正中目標。

cues.en: Congratulations, we actually made our final model and now I just want to conclude this tutorial by making this transition to one of our future part
cues.zh: 恭喜，最後一個模型完成了。最後想銜接到後面的部分，

cues.en: which is actually part 10.
cues.zh: 也就是第十部分。

cues.en: In part 10, we will build some ensemble machine learning models that is some models that are a combination of several machine learning models.
cues.zh: 第十部分會建立集成機器學習模型，也就是多個模型的組合。

cues.en: And you know, in machine learning these are actually the best models.
cues.zh: 在機器學習中，這些往往是最好的模型。

cues.en: You know, when you have a team of several machine learning models they can actually make an awesome prediction because unless we have a ninch time machine learning model in our combination of machine learning models
cues.zh: 多個模型組隊，可能做出很棒的預測；除非組合裡有一個像愛因斯坦的模型，

cues.en: that is the only model to be right.
cues.zh: 而且只有它正確。

cues.en: Well, you are more likely to get the correct prediction with 10 machine learning models predicting the same thing than with just one model.
cues.zh: 一般來說，十個模型預測同一件事，比單一模型更可能得到正確結果。

cues.en: So, that's actually what we did here.
cues.zh: 這就是我們剛做的事。

cues.en: Well, we had a team of same machine learning models which were decision tree regression models but in the future we'll make a team of different machine learning models.
cues.zh: 這次團隊由相同種類的決策樹迴歸模型組成，之後則會結合不同種類的模型。

cues.en: So, that's gonna be very fun, that's gonna be very powerful as well and I look forward to getting there with you.
cues.zh: 會很有趣，也很強大，期待和你一起學。

cues.en: So, now I'm telling you congratulations for two things.
cues.zh: 現在要為兩件事恭喜你。

cues.en: First, for building this very powerful regression model, the random forest regression model.
cues.zh: 第一，建立了強大的隨機森林迴歸模型。

cues.en: And second, for having built all our regression models.
cues.zh: 第二，完成所有迴歸模型。

cues.en: We build some linear regression models, some non-linear regression models, some non-linear non-continuous regression models, and some non-linear non-continuous
cues.zh: 建立了線性、非線性、非線性且不連續，以及非線性、不連續的

cues.en: and symbol regression model.
cues.zh: 集成迴歸模型。

cues.en: So congratulations, you're definitely on your way to becoming some experts in machine learning but wait for what's coming next.
cues.zh: 恭喜，你已朝機器學習專家邁進，但精彩內容還在後面。

cues.en: So, speaking of what's coming next, I look forward to seeing you in the next sections or next part.
cues.zh: 期待在接下來的章節與部分見到你。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
